target_pdb.description: Absolute path to the target structure (PDB or mmCIF) the binder is designed against.

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path, full_structure_path, or backbone_path into `target_pdb` when omitted.

target_chain.description: Chain id of the target on `target_pdb`. Defaults to A when the user did not specify a chain, which is conventional for monomer targets and a bounded starting point for multimer targets. Override when the requested binding region is on a different chain.

binder_length.description: Desired binder residue count. Defaults to 60 aa when the user did not request a length; override when the task states a size or interface geometry constraint.

num_samples.description: Number of diffusion samples to draw.

temperature.description: Diffusion sampling temperature. 1.0 is the model's calibrated default; tweak for diversity/quality trade-offs.

hotspots.description: 1-indexed target residue positions where the binder should engage (PXDesign hotspot syntax).

crop.description: Optional target-region selector (chain-specific crop). Null uses the full target chain.

top_k_designs.description: Maximum number of generated sequence-design artifacts to return.

mpnn_temperature.description: ProteinMPNN sampling temperature used in the sequence-design stage.
